title: Assignment 4 - Multi-Agent System (MAS) with n8n
important_note: This JSON documents the workflow inferred from the provided screenshots. It is not a verified native n8n workflow export and may not import into n8n. To obtain an import-ready workflow, export the actual workflow from your n8n instance using Download/Export workflow.
purpose: Demonstrate sequential orchestration of two AI Agent nodes, with a Groq Chat Model, Simple Memory, and a Tavily web-search tool.

observed_components.name: When chat message received
observed_components.purpose: Starts a run when a user submits a chat message.

observed_components.name: AI Agent
observed_components.purpose: Processes the incoming user request according to its configured prompt and connected model/tools.

observed_components.name: AI Agent1
observed_components.purpose: Receives the first agent's output and performs the next configured agent step.

observed_components.name: Groq Chat Model
observed_components.purpose: Provides language-model inference for the connected agent node(s).

observed_components.name: Simple Memory
observed_components.purpose: Provides conversation context to the agent connection shown in the workflow.

observed_components.name: Search the web in Tavily
observed_components.purpose: Allows the connected agent to search the web when its configuration calls for it.

observed_sequence.description: The chat message triggers the workflow and enters the first agent.
The first agent's output is passed to the second agent.
The model is connected as an agent language model; exact connection mapping should be verified against the original n8n canvas.
Memory is attached to the agent connection shown in the original workflow screenshot.
Tavily is exposed as a tool to the connected agent; the exact agent and runtime invocation should be checked in n8n.
The workflow returns the resulting response to the chat interface.

test_example.expected_behavior: The agents produce a natural-language response about Lionel Messi according to their configured prompts and available tools.
test_example.verification_note: Do not claim a response was web-verified unless the n8n execution trace confirms that Tavily was called for that run.
